description: App runtime and UI hardening across the 5 module pages and agentcore_utils. Migrates every LIVE BedrockModel(...) construction to make_model, converts bare metric-dict reads to .get(), adds an honest live-vs-local AWS status caption under each module page title, streams single-agent chat where safe, and adds a per-session estimated cost/latency panel on Module 4. Depends on FEAT-001 (make_model must exist). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Migrate live BedrockModel sites to make_model (see context.json live_bedrockmodel_sites), preserving overrides and NEVER touching st.code display strings: M1 judge_response (~103) and judge_orchestrator_response (~235) -> make_model('judge'); M2 Part2 prompt-caching agent (~203) -> make_model('generation', cache_tools='default'); M2 Part3 Summarizing agent (~352) -> make_model('generation'); M2 context-failure judge (~679) -> make_model('judge'); M3 judge_security (~133) and judge_cedar (~398) -> make_model('judge'); M4 Part3 judge _BM max_tokens=1024 (~367) -> make_model('judge', max_tokens=1024); M5 economy (~31) -> make_model('generation', model_id='apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0', max_tokens=1024); M5 premium (~33) -> make_model('generation', max_tokens=2048); agentcore_utils AgentCoreEvaluator.evaluate fallback (~206) -> make_model('judge'). Import make_model from agent_utils in each file. Remove now-dead 'from strands.models import BedrockModel' imports ONLY where nothing else references BedrockModel (M2 likely still needs it for display/other use — check before removing).

In app/pages/2_Module_2_Context.py convert bare metric-dict reads to .get(key, 0): Part1 metric block ~88-99 (m['inputTokens'|'outputTokens'|'totalTokens'] and prev['inputTokens'|'totalTokens'] delta expressions), context progress ~104-105 (latest['inputTokens']), metric columns ~134-137 (metrics['inputTokens'|'totalTokens'] and prev[...] in the delta expressions), Part5 token-log sums ~605-606 (entry['totalTokens'], entry['inputTokens']). Do NOT touch the st.code display block (~191-192) that prints usage['cacheReadInputTokens'].

Add live_services_caption() to app/style.py: call agentcore_utils.get_agentcore_status() and render ONE subtle st.caption line summarizing which services resolved to live AWS vs local simulation plus the region (e.g. '🟢 Live AWS: Memory, Evaluator · Region ap-southeast-1' or '⚪ Local simulation — no AWS services resolved · Region ...'). Guard with try/except so a failure degrades silently. Call it once at module scope near the top of each of pages 1-5 (a single consistent spot after inject_css()). Do NOT add it to Home.py and do NOT re-introduce per-service sidebar badges; keep Home's existing status line unchanged.

Add estimate_cost(model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens) -> float to app/agent_utils.py with an illustrative per-model price table keyed by the 5 ids in _VALID_MODEL_IDS, documented in a comment as 'estimated, not billing-accurate'. Unknown model ids fall back to a default rate. Returns a non-negative float.

On app/pages/4_Module_4_Observability.py Part 1 add one compact st.container(border=True) panel labeled 'Estimated session cost' summing st.session_state.m4p1_metrics: total tokens, total/avg latency, and estimated cost via estimate_cost(current model id, sum inputTokens, sum outputTokens). Use .get(...) for every metric read. Do not disturb the existing per-turn metric columns or the thread-safe tool_counter.

Stream single-agent chat where plain chat_response is used and no metrics/judge depend on the response object: M1 Part 1 (m1p1_agent: both the pills path and the chat_input path — capture resp = st.write_stream(chat_stream(agent, msg)), then run the existing judge on resp and append resp to m1p1_msgs), M1 Part 3 (m1p3_agent). Leave M4 Part 1 and M5 Part 1 BLOCKING because they use chat_response_with_metrics and need the metrics object. Preserve submit_mode='disable', session_state keys, and judge behavior.
acceptance_criteria: `cd app && python3 -m py_compile pages/*.py agentcore_utils.py style.py` exits 0.
`grep -rn "BedrockModel(" app/pages app/agentcore_utils.py` returns only matches inside st.code( display blocks (M2 only); no live construction remains.

`grep -nE "(m|prev|latest|metrics|entry)\[['\"](inputTokens|outputTokens|totalTokens|latencyMs|toolCalls|cacheReadInputTokens|cacheWriteInputTokens)['\"]\]" app/pages/2_Module_2_Context.py` returns only matches inside the st.code display block.
`grep -rln "live_services_caption" app/pages` lists all 5 module pages; `grep -c "live_services_caption" app/Home.py` returns 0.
`cd app && python3 -c "import agent_utils as a; print(a.estimate_cost('global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5',1000,500) >= 0)"` prints True.
`grep -n "write_stream" app/pages/1_Module_1_Multi_Agent.py` shows streaming wired into Part 1 and Part 3; judge still receives the full streamed string.
M4 thread-safe tool_counter and all session_state keys preserved; Diagram/About/Prompts tabs and part_header unchanged.
verification: cd app && python3 -m py_compile pages/1_Module_1_Multi_Agent.py pages/2_Module_2_Context.py pages/3_Module_3_Security.py pages/4_Module_4_Observability.py pages/5_Module_5_Well_Architected.py agentcore_utils.py style.py
cd app && python3 -c "import agent_utils as a; assert a.estimate_cost('global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5',1000,500) >= 0; print('cost ok')"
findings:
Landed in the working tree (no commit). All verification commands pass; app py_compile + offline imports succeed.

MODEL MIGRATIONS (all live BedrockModel(...) -> make_model):
- M1: judge_response and judge_orchestrator_response -> make_model('judge'). Removed 'from strands.models import BedrockModel' (M1 only referenced it at those 2 live sites; the st.code blocks reference strands.multiagent, not BedrockModel).
- M2: Part2 caching agent -> make_model('generation', cache_tools='default'); Part3 Summarizing agent -> make_model('generation'); Part6 context-failure judge -> make_model('judge'). Removed the BedrockModel import (M2's only remaining BedrockModel( tokens are the st.code DISPLAY strings at lines 173/320/420 — not live code).
- M3: judge_security and judge_cedar_policy -> make_model('judge'). Removed BedrockModel import and the local 'from agent_utils import _get_judge_model_id' lines in both judge fns.
- M4: Part3 judge (_BM, max_tokens=1024) -> make_model('judge', max_tokens=1024). Dropped the local '_BM'/'_get_judge_model_id' imports; kept 'from strands import Agent as _A'.
- M5: economy -> make_model('generation', model_id='apac.amazon.nova-micro-v1:0', max_tokens=1024); premium -> make_model('generation', max_tokens=2048). Removed BedrockModel import (remaining BedrockModel( at line 381 is an st.code display string).
- agentcore_utils AgentCoreEvaluator.evaluate local fallback -> make_model('judge'); replaced 'from strands.models import BedrockModel as _BM' + '_get_judge_model_id' with 'from agent_utils import make_model'.

CONFIRMED remaining 'BedrockModel(' matches are ONLY st.code display strings: M5:381, M2:173, M2:320, M2:420. No live construction remains.

METRIC .get() (M2 only): Part1 historical metric block (m/prev inputTokens/outputTokens/totalTokens + deltas), context progress (latest.get('inputTokens',0)), Part1 inline metric columns delta exprs (metrics/prev), Part5 token-log sums (entry.get('totalTokens'/'inputTokens', 0)). Left the st.code display block at ~191-192 (usage['cacheReadInputTokens']) untouched. The acceptance grep for bare (m|prev|latest|metrics|entry)[...] now returns NO matches in M2.

style.live_services_caption(): new fn. Calls agentcore_utils.get_agentcore_status(); renders ONE st.caption — '🟢 Live AWS: <names> · Region <r>' when any of memory/evaluator/guardrail/cognito/policy_store/gateway resolved, else '⚪ Local simulation — no AWS services resolved · Region <r>'. Wrapped in try/except so failure renders nothing. Called once at module scope right after inject_css() on all 5 module pages (1-5). NOT added to Home.py (grep -c = 0); no sidebar badges reintroduced.

estimate_cost(model_id, input_tokens, output_tokens) -> float in agent_utils.py. _PRICE_PER_1K table keyed by the 5 _VALID_MODEL_IDS (input,output USD per 1k), commented 'ESTIMATED, NOT BILLING-ACCURATE'. Unknown ids -> _DEFAULT_PRICE_PER_1K (0.001, 0.005). Clamps negatives, returns non-negative float.

M4 estimated-cost panel: added a second st.container(border=True) '💰 Estimated session cost' directly under the existing Observability Dashboard container in Part 1, inside the 'if st.session_state.m4p1_metrics' block. Shows Total Tokens, Total Latency, Avg Latency, Est. Cost (USD) via estimate_cost(agent_utils._get_model_id(), total_input, total_output). All reads use .get(...). Per-turn metric columns and the thread-safe m4p1_tool_counter (plain list) are untouched. Imported make_model + estimate_cost at M4 top.

M1 STREAMING: Part 1 (m1p1_agent) both pills and chat_input paths and Part 3 (m1p3_agent) both pills and chat_input paths now use resp = st.write_stream(chat_stream(agent, msg)). The Part 1 judge still runs on the full streamed `resp` string and resp is still appended to m1p1_msgs/m1p1_judgments. submit_mode='disable', all session_state keys, and judge behavior preserved. M1 Part 2 (orchestrator, has judge) left BLOCKING via chat_response. M4 Part1 and M5 Part1 left BLOCKING (they need the metrics object).

All Diagram/About/Prompts tabs, part_header, relative diagram paths untouched. make_model/chat_stream imported where used. Verification: py_compile of all 5 pages + agentcore_utils + style exits 0; estimate_cost >= 0; grep confirms only display-string BedrockModel( remain; all 5 pages list live_services_caption, Home has 0. No AWS calls, no Streamlit started, no commit.
